title: Williams–Brice Stadium (2006)

terrainReference.basis: Original USGS one-metre bare-earth survey sampled at the center of the mapped playing surface.

identities.name: Williams-Brice Stadium
identities.address: 1125 George Rogers Boulevard, Columbia, South Carolina

mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap stadium shell, playing-field control and side-deck outlines, calibrated against two exact public-domain Qualla photographs taken on the same 2006 game day.

note: The university documents the two main upper decks, end-zone additions and the date of the later north scoreboard. The 2006 photographs provide the major bearing frames, ramp tiers, lighting beams and press box proportions.
